title: Required Savings date is validated two steps late
evidence: Leave target date blank at step1; choose people; continue; Review group at step3 reports Choose a target date. Back twice to correct it.
recommendation: Validate required goal fields on Choose people, mark requirements, and focus the date error beside its field. Preserve draft and final authoritative validation.
authority_boundary: Integration behavior correction; check C1 allows earlier validation, no new product rule.

title: Empty-state text is constrained to a narrow column
evidence: Payment history and Savings Recent render ordinary sentences as a one-word vertical stack inside a wide card.
recommendation: Give empty-state prose its full card width; avoid inheriting icon/text/action grid columns; retain exact semantic copy.
authority_boundary: CSS integration repair; compare the same empty states against approved source layouts.

title: Bottom navigation changes composition across families
evidence: Core uses Pots/People/Add/Activity/You; account/data/lifecycle use Pots/Groups/Add/People/You. Import displays a footer with non-actionable text in the AX tree. Recovery links intentionally route through an owner boundary.
recommendation: Keep approved destinations/permissions, but resolve a consistent integrated navigation contract; unavailable destinations must look unavailable and explain why. Never make blocked actions silently successful.
authority_boundary: Cross-Golden/C1 product decision may be needed for navigation composition; record separately before changing frozen sources.

certainty: Confirmed content burden; usability impact inferred
title: Engineering concepts dominate ordinary task copy
evidence: Profile discusses cryptographic identity/personhood; Wallet repeats inert fixture/no signing disclaimers; export shows long source hashes, participant IDs and unverified-export-reference as primary review facts.
recommendation: Use one concise prototype notice; put detailed provenance/authority diagnostics behind Details. Translate owner truth into current status and Return to payment. Keep all meaningful safety and limitation disclosures.
authority_boundary: Copy/progressive disclosure needs comparison with approved copy and documented post-Golden impacts; no guardrail weakening.

title: Empty Home exposes many secondary destinations
evidence: Eight destination buttons under the first-group task use dashed pale styling similar to unavailable controls.
recommendation: Prioritize Start group; collect secondary tasks into predictable navigation or a labelled More section. Enabled secondary controls should look enabled.
authority_boundary: Hierarchy change needs bounded Golden-impact review; do not remove supported journeys.

title: Guest expense Back to group lands on Home
evidence: After saving UX audit dinner, Back to group opens the Home list; Open UX audit group is another required action.
recommendation: Return to the newly affected group, or accurately label the Home destination. Preserve the canonical group selection.
authority_boundary: Integration route fix; preserve the accepted group-home meaning.

title: Review status routes an unassigned owner to History
evidence: The 0 of1 reviewed / Status row opens History twice, including a semantic-label click. Source gate-b/app.js routes unassigned actors to history intentionally; owner is not eligible to agree as reviewer.
recommendation: Offer a read-only review-status summary or label the History destination clearly. Do not let owners manufacture another participant review.
authority_boundary: Read-only status presentation; permission behavior is correct, not a security defect.

title: Blank expense fields lack visible task labels
evidence: Amount and description have accessible names, but blank visible lines provide little guidance about what to type.
recommendation: Retain accessible labels and add persistent visible Amount/Description labels or approved hints that survive input.
authority_boundary: Compare against approved Golden; visible-copy addition needs bounded review.

title: Small secondary targets and type
evidence: Inspect See all measured32×11CSSpx with10px type; form Cancel396×34 with9px type. Main actions are large; Back is36×36. Some targets are measured in expanded menus.
recommendation: Increase secondary hit area and readable type while keeping visual hierarchy. Check neighboring target spacing and actual touch behavior.
authority_boundary: CSS/target repair; no blanket WCAG violation asserted from dimensions alone.

title: Local add-person panel sits below the success screen
evidence: Gate A create confirmation remains above injected person form; Done is near/under fixed actions until scrolling. Actual J04 invite screen is much clearer.
recommendation: Focus the local-person panel and ensure Done stays visible; reuse approved Invite layout only where semantics match.
authority_boundary: Integration layout repair; local named person is not a verified remote membership.

title: Expense history shows raw timestamps/action names
evidence: History displays create and an ISO timestamp instead of a readable event/date. Activity already has more readable timestamps.
recommendation: Render Created expense and local date/time; retain exact timestamp in Details.
authority_boundary: Presentation-only; history bytes and lineage stay unchanged.

title: Rescan and local-reference checks appear before the first scan
evidence: Initial QR screen mixes Scan, Check reference, Rescan and Return account. Local fixture explanation is shown in ordinary mode.
recommendation: Show Rescan after a result; separate the prototype reference tool from the normal scanner path, retaining explicit simulation disclosure.
authority_boundary: State-dependent presentation; no camera permission or external payload was exercised.

certainty: Confirmed interaction; user comprehension impact not measured
title: Simulated account approval has no discoverable local completion path
evidence: Email claims Sent to a synthetic address; wallet requests approval elsewhere. Product mode hides entry-demohelp including local code/outcome instructions. Prototype badge/guide discloses simulation but does not tell the person how to finish this step.
recommendation: Keep simulation disclosed, show the public local code/labelled outcome path at the action, and avoid implying external delivery. Keep pending/verification binding unchanged.
authority_boundary: Integrated wrapper/fixture disclosure correction proposal; compare approved entry decision and source before changing runtime. No new product rule or frozen-source edit.

certainty: Confirmed interaction; user comprehension impact not measured

evidence: Guest Home -> Invite someone -> Create account -> email Back reaches old welcome with email/wallet only. No guest or Home exit is visible.
recommendation: Route Back according to the incoming guest/account/invite context, preserving the accepted minimal entry and guest work. Do not modify frozen Goldens.
authority_boundary: Integrated wrapper/fixture disclosure correction proposal; compare approved entry decision and source before changing runtime. No new product rule or frozen-source edit.

evidence: Host reload at code entry restores Guest Home and saved records, but loses conversion step and invite intent. Whether the auth step must restart is a bounded product/security decision.
recommendation: Specify safe destination persistence or explicitly disclose restart. Never persist or reuse auth proof merely to preserve UX.
